comparison.objective: Cock a sprung phone holder, place and align a phone, trigger its arms, and leave the phone safely clamped. Candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires bimanual spring-arm opening, latch cocking, phone transport/alignment, and controlled trigger release. Candidate requires small recessed-tool engagement, counterholding, collar adjustment, force-limited relocking, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires edge clamping within millimetric pose tolerances, no free fall or glass-face capture, hands clear, and 1 s stillness. Candidate requires two non-bottoming physical cycles within rated energy, velocity, and stroke limits with no overload, excessive rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: The record tests cock-place-trigger latching and safe payload support; the candidate tests adjustable hydraulic-stop behavior and lock retention. Spring mechanisms and bimanual coordination are only generic shared primitives. Candidate rebound, overload, drift, and witness-torque thresholds remain incomplete.
